nodes.summary: Print the typed write plan for one input; writes no file
usage: corvint-postmerge-connect plan --experimental --root REPO --fixture FILE --policy FILE --input FILE [--mode dry-run]
nodes.example: corvint-postmerge-connect plan --experimental --root REPO --fixture FILE --policy FILE --input FILE

nodes.summary: Read the source item through the fixture and save the intake file outside the authoring worktree
usage: corvint-postmerge-connect read-intake --experimental --root REPO --fixture FILE --policy FILE --input FILE --output FILE --author-root DIR [--mode dry-run]
nodes.example: corvint-postmerge-connect read-intake --experimental --root REPO --fixture FILE --policy FILE --input FILE --output FILE --author-root DIR

nodes.summary: Apply the plan in dry-run, recording or local-fixture live mode
usage: corvint-postmerge-connect write --experimental --root REPO --fixture FILE --policy FILE --input FILE [--mode dry-run|recording|live] [--output FILE] [--author-root DIR]
nodes.example: corvint-postmerge-connect write --experimental --root REPO --fixture FILE --policy FILE --input FILE
